structure: Single master PDF 'Washington State K-12 Learning Standards for Social Studies' (OSPI, 2019). Front matter pp.1-12 (u1-u115): cover, license, adoption statement, TOC, introduction, numbering/C3 explanation. Then three grade-band parts: Elementary Grades K-5 (u116-u575/u578), Middle School 6-8 (u580-u891), High School 9-12 (u893-u1154); each opens with a band overview (Skills, World History, Washington State, U.S. History narratives) and a table of five overarching Learning Standard statements (Social Studies Skills, Civics, Economics, Geography, History). Standards pages are two-column tables (one table per page): left cell [T1 R1 C1] 'Components' with the standards text, right cell [T1 R1 C2] 'Sample Questions'. Each page begins with the discipline name (Social Studies Skills / Civics / Economics / Geography / History) and a performance-standard line (SSS1-4, C1-C4, E1-E4, G1-G3, H1-H4), then an Enduring Understanding (bullet-prefixed lines under the performance standard), then the Components and Sample Questions cells, then a Since Time Immemorial / Native Knowledge 360 curriculum cross-reference line (Pathways, Washington State History Units, Middle/High School Curriculum). Component codes: <letter(s)><performance std>.<grade or band>.<component>, e.g. SSS1.K.1, C1.3.2, H1.6-8.4, E2.11-12.3, with 'By the end of <grade>, students will:' sub-headers inside the cell. K-5 pages alternate K-2 pages (K,1,2 in one cell) and 3-5 pages (3,4,5 in one cell); 6-8 cells hold (World) 6th, (WA) 7th, (US) 8th together; 9-12 cells hold 9/10 and 11/12 together. Tables that overflow continue on the next page with 'Components'/'Sample Questions' column labels. Appendices (FAQ, bibliography, acknowledgments, back cover) are pp.110-119 (u1156-u1357).

issues: Document is one PDF extract where every table cell holds a whole band: K-5 'Components' cells hold K,1,2 (K-2 pages) or 3,4,5 (3-5 pages) together; 6-8 cells hold 6th (World), 7th (WA), 8th (US) together; 9-12 cells hold 9/10 and 11/12 together. Units cannot be split, so each such cell is labeled with its whole band (K-2, 3-5, 6-8, 9-12). Sample Questions cells and Enduring Understandings are likewise per band.

Pathways / 'Middle School Curriculum' / 'High School Curriculum' lines (Since Time Immemorial and Native Knowledge 360 curriculum cross-references, e.g. u146, u157, u613-u614, u922-u924) are labeled examples (content-related support, not standards); alternatively backup. Includes u222, u225 etc. where only a page-continuation heading and the cross-reference exist.
Enduring Understanding lines (bullet-prefixed text under each performance standard, plus the 'Enduring Understanding:' label e.g. u289, u302) are labeled examples.

Page 23, 26, 29, 32, 35, 40, 49, 60, 69, 72, 81, 97, 101, 105, 108 are spill-over pages whose tables continue from the previous page; their heading (e.g. u222 'Social Studies Skills', u246 'Civics') is labeled standards with the grade band of the preceding page, and the cross-reference line is examples.

u265-u271: C2.5.5 component text is cut at the page break (u265 ends 'explain'); continuation is u271 (page 29, left column x=74) and labeled standards 3-5. Same split for E2.5.2-4 (u366-u371), G2.5.7 (u462-u463) and E2.11-12.6-7 (u1034-u1037).

u268/u364/u460/u1032 'C o m p o n e n t s' and u270/u365/u461/u1033 'Sample Questions' are repeated column header labels on continuation pages; Components label labeled standards, Sample Questions label labeled examples.

u116-u117, u580-u581, u893-u894 band title lines ('Grades K-5 / Elementary School Standards by Discipline' etc.) labeled backup; band overview narratives (u118-u125, u582-u594 etc.) labeled examples. 6-8 narratives for World History (6th), Washington State (7th), U.S. History (8th) are labeled 6-8 because the guide's row cluster is 6-8 and cells combine all three grades.

u131-u135, u598-u602, u908-u912: the overarching 'Learning Standard' statement per discipline (Skills, Civics, Economics, Geography, History) labeled standards for the band; the 'color icon'/'standard' header units (u129-u130, u596-u597, u906-u907) are backup.
u594: 'These standards can be addressed over multiple grade levels (6-8) at the discretion of the district' labeled backup (implementation note).

HS content is grade-banded 9-10 and 11-12 in the same cell; no named high-school courses appear as headings (U.S. History 11th, Contemporary World Problems 12th, Native Knowledge 360 appear only in curriculum cross-reference lines), so course is null throughout and grades are 9-12.
